name: plugin-source-example
description: Reference plugin example - contributing operations through a source plugin

askturret.testsNotRequired: Runnable demo, not a library. Unlike its exporter sibling it DOES own its plugin, because a source plugin is adopter code by definition and there is no shipped reference source to load. That would normally be the rot risk plugin-otel-exporter warns about, so this example is executed by CI (test-integrity, 'Plugin examples run') rather than merely built: it compiles its operations through the real compiler, so a broken plugin seam fails the build instead of printing something plausible.
